SOURCES SOUGHT

DLA Weapons Support (Columbus) is preparing to solicit a long-term contract for the NSN 1005-007070725. This announcement is considered market research in accordance with FAR Part 10. The solicitation will be synopsized separately later. The purpose of this notice is to identify qualified business concerns interested in submitting a proposal on the below listed NSN.

Item details are as follows:

NSN 1005-007070725

COVER,GUN MOUNT

Estimated Annual Demand Quantity (ADQ) – 367

Unit of Issue – Each

North American Industry Classification System Codes (NAICS) – 332994

NAICS Business Size – 1,000

The associated drawing number is listed below:

IAW REFERENCE DRAWING NR (19207) 7070795

Sources interested in submitting a proposal on this forthcoming solicitation should complete the attached market research questionnaire and spreadsheet and return the completed copies to Samantha Simms at samantha.simms@dla.mil by April 22nd, 2026.

Notice Attachments Include:

1. Market Research Questionnaire

2. Market Research NSN Spreadsheet

3. Product Item Description (PID)
